title: Choose the Visual World for Portfolio Redesign
question: The roll assigned The Kinematic Engineering Lab. Choose the visual direction for Maulana Ferdi's portfolio landing page.

options.label: The Kinematic Engineering Lab
options.lineage: Interactive precision instruments & hardware test benches
options.thesis: Every project treated as a live, operating engineering specimen with interactive probes, verified telemetry, and tactile state controls.
options.viewport: Monumental dual-plane hero: left side anchors command narrative & verified status; right side houses an interactive kinematic specimen engine with live state probes and tangible telemetry.
options.risk: Requires meticulous tactile micro-interactions to feel like physical hardware rather than a flat schematic.

raised.raise: Tangible stepped sequencer controls and illuminated state keys embedded into the project inspect engine.
Laser-sharp tabular density and zero-fluff data precision for metrics and performance telemetry.

options.label: The Modernist Architectural Monograph
options.thesis: Architectural grid authority: monumental typography, disciplined white-space, and structural blueprint callouts demonstrating taste and rigor.
options.viewport: Full-bleed typographic masthead with structural elevation grid, live coordinate markers, and full-width project case plates.
options.risk: Familiar in high-end design portfolios; risks feeling austere if not energized by dynamic interaction.

options.label: The Rhythm Matrix & Instrument Console
options.lineage: Vintage step sequencers and hardware rhythm synthesizers
options.thesis: The portfolio as an interactive soundboard/matrix where every engineering project is an active track with tempo, channels, and live modulation.
options.viewport: A 16-channel interactive console header with live transport controls, triggering project stems and interactive demos.
options.case: Exceptional interactive tactile engagement; holds user attention immediately; slightly less conventional for enterprise hiring managers.
options.risk: Audience might treat it as a music toy rather than a serious senior full-stack portfolio.

options.label: Pure Datamatics & Spectral Lattice
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda datamatics and high-frequency spectral displays
options.case: Visually arresting minimalism, but loses recruiter readability for narrative case studies.
options.kept: Laser-sharp tabular density and zero-fluff data precision.

canonCard.label: The Modern Developer Standard
canonCard.thesis: Standard developer portfolio: dark background, hero tagline, centered CTAs, and a grid of 3-column project cards.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, subhead, GitHub and Contact buttons, followed by standard cards.
canonCard.risk: Blends completely into the sea of generic developer websites; forgotten in 30 seconds.
